Key Colours from a Categorical Palette

Source: R/figure-data.R
PlotDataKeyColours.Rd

Assigns colours to integer keys (for example cluster numbers) by cycling through one or more categorical palettes: key k takes colour ((k - first) mod n) + 1 of the joined palettes.

Usage

PlotDataKeyColours(
  keys,
  column = "key",
  palettes = c("tab20", "tab20b"),
  first = 1
)

Arguments

keys

Keys: a vector, or a data frame whose column holds them.

column

Key column when keys is a data frame.

palettes

Palette names: "tab20", "tab20b", "tab20c" or "clusters" (the style's cluster palette), joined in order.

first

Key that takes the first colour.

Value

A data frame with key and colour, sorted by key.

See also

Other plot-data builders: PlotDataBindRows(), PlotDataConstant(), PlotDataCount(), PlotDataCrossShares(), PlotDataDirection(), PlotDataDominant(), PlotDataFromArrays(), PlotDataJoin(), PlotDataLabels(), PlotDataLonger(), PlotDataMembership(), PlotDataPairRatio(), PlotDataProduct(), PlotDataQuantiles(), PlotDataRankRows(), PlotDataRatio(), PlotDataRecode(), PlotDataRelative(), PlotDataSelect(), PlotDataShares(), PlotDataSummarise(), PlotDataUnite()

PlotDataKeyColours(1:25)
